entities.name: Fields of Strife
entities.description: Site in the Tor-Kathorra Desert on Arcavios of a perpetual battle waged by restless spirits of the Blood Age.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: Plane on which the Fields of Strife lie.

entities.name: Blood Age
entities.description: An especially bloody period of Arcavios spanning millennia whose battles concentrated in the Fields of Strife.

entities.name: Lorehold
entities.description: Strixhaven college studying the spirits and maintaining camps at the Fields.

entities.name: Camp Herrian
entities.description: Camp named for one of Strixhaven's first deans, on the outskirts of the battle.

entities.name: Pranticle Peak
entities.description: Mesa that was the site of a famous battle between Kor and owlin forces.

entities.name: Armory Arch
entities.description: Large star arch formed from an ancient armory.

entities.name: Lost Barracks
entities.description: Off-limits area with exaggerated hypnotic undercurrent.

entities.name: Dean Augusta Tullus
entities.description: Dean who approved a temporary teaching assistant position for an expedition in 4565 AR.

entities.name: Mica
entities.description: Geomancer assistant who helped document a Blood Age cache.

entities.name: Stella Lee
entities.description: Off-plane looter who intruded on the Blood Age cache and was repelled.

events.summary: The Fields of Strife are formed during the Blood Age of Arcavios.
events.quote: The Fields of Strife were formed during the Blood Age of Arcavios

events.summary: On an expedition in 4565 AR, a student discovers a subterranean cache of Blood Age artifacts, and later confronts and repels the looter Stella Lee.
events.quote: he discovered evidence of prior intrusion by the off-plane looter
